answer: Sparse-cut conductance detection resists sybils: the honest region connects to any sybil region only through the few attack edges an adversary can forge, so that boundary has low conductance, a structural signal. The system searches for cuts where internal density far exceeds crossing edges and quarantines the thin side. A hive of fakes densely wired still hangs off a handful of crossing edges, a nectar-trap bottleneck no internal wiring widens. Honest agents anchor into the well-mixed core with high crossing conductance. Precondition: attack edges stay few relative to the honest cut size.
